description: Source code for convolution operations in QNNPACK, including creation and setup functions for 2D and 3D convolutions with quantization, handling indirection buffers, kernel packing, and parameter validation.

methods.name: compute_output_dimension
methods.description: Calculates the output dimension size for convolution based on input size, kernel size, dilation, and subsampling.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_create_convolution_ndhwc_q8
methods.description: Creates a convolution operator for 2D or 3D convolution in NHWC format with quantization parameters.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_create_convolution2d_nhwc_q8
methods.description: Creates a 2D convolution operator in NHWC format with quantization.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_create_convolution3d_ndhwc_q8
methods.description: Creates a 3D convolution operator in NDHWC format with quantization.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_setup_convolution_ndhwc_q8
methods.description: Configures the convolution operator with input/output data pointers and dimensions.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_setup_convolution2d_nhwc_q8
methods.description: Sets up a 2D NHWC convolution with input/output pointers and batch size.
